Batch crawl stream emits both Page and Error events for mixed success/failure URLs

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.crawlberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val engineConfig = mapper.readValue("{\"max_concurrent\":1}", CrawlConfig::class.java)
    val engine = Crawlberg.createEngine(engineConfig)
    val req = mapper.readValue("{\"batch_urls\":[\"https://example.com/success1\",\"https://example.com/fail\",\"https://example.com/success2\"]}", BatchCrawlStreamRequest::class.java)
    val result = engine.batchCrawlStream(req)
    println(result.stream.hasPageEvent)
    println(result.stream.hasErrorEvent)
    println(result.stream.hasCompleteEvent)
}
```
